subject: P1: Observe — warn on every global-workspace fallback
description: Phase 1 of deprecating the daemon global workspace pointer (see system note "SPEC: deprecate daemon global workspace pointer"). ZERO behavior change. Add a one-line warning (process.stderr.write, throttled/deduped per route+caller) at every seam where an op resolves to state.workspace because no explicit workspace was passed: targetOverlay (daemon.js ~431), the read paths that do `ws===state.workspace ? state.overlay : overlayStore.load(ws)`, and the sweep/loop defaults (ws=state.workspace). Goal: surface which callers still rely on the silent fallback so P2b/P3 don't miss any. Emit a structured tag like `orch.workspace-fallback route=<x> caller=<y>` once per distinct seam. Add a test asserting the warning fires when workspace is omitted and is silent when passed. Commit on the attempt branch. Deliverable summary MUST list every distinct fallback seam observed (this list feeds P2b/P3).
